posts.zh:
dsh-mask 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。PII 脱敏中间件：姓名/电话/身份证/银行卡等在到达模型前匿名化为占位符，展示层还原，绝不记录明文。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4a7b742a548c702d49d5.html
posts.en:
dsh-mask is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. PII redaction middleware: names, phone numbers, ID cards, and bank cards are anonymized to placeholders before reaching the model and restored at the display layer; plaintext is never logged.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4a7b742a548c702d49d5.html
